mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy supports risk-taking.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances with UNRATE decline > 0.2pp, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increases above 1.5% and consumer spending declines exceeding 0.5% over two months signal monetary tightening outpacing demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 1.5% AND RSAFS falls > 0.5% in 2 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 150,000 persons indicates robust labor market conditions that sustain consumer spending and corporate profitability, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points over three months signals aggressive monetary tightening that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous consumer spending growth exceeding 0.3% over two months and unemployment rate declines exceeding 0.1 percentage points over one month signal strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.3% in 2 months AND UNRATE falls > 0.1pp in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered instances, or interaction Rank IC is below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth rate exceeding 1.5% annualized signals robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with GDPC1 growth rate > 1.5% annualized, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
